reasoning_evidence: Executed IA Exhibit B Time Schedule: In-Service Date(s) May 13, 2027; Scheduled Trial Operation Date May 30, 2027; Scheduled Commercial Operation Date September 30, 2027 — EXACTLY matches reported queue COD claim (sources/..._be.pdf, sheet04 p31) — the claim is contractually grounded, not just a queue self-report
Queue history: 3 prior COD slips, ~20 months cumulative drift, all BEFORE this IA was executed (2025-11-21); COD has been stable at 2027-09-30 in every snapshot since IA signing (see timeline.md)

EIA-860M (Birch Creek Development, plant 67552): planned COD stuck at 2026-06 since 2024-05 (5 quarters before queue/IA COD 2027-09-30) -- stale planned-COD field, not a competing independent estimate. BUT EIA status field flipped from '(P) Planned, regulatory approvals not initiated' (through 2025-11) to '(U) Under construction, <=50% complete' starting 2025-12-01 (eia_history.json) -- this DIVERGES from our own satellite read of no visible activity as of 2026-06-15. Two explanations: (a) EIA status categories are coarse and some developers self-report 'under construction' upon IA execution / financial security posting rather than physical groundbreaking, or (b) activity began after 2026-06-15 that we could not re-check because CDSE's openEO backend was unreachable this session (7 retry attempts, RemoteDisconnected, valid cached token). Logged as an open divergence, not resolved.

No construction visible as of 2026-06-15 satellite imagery (most recent available), ~11 months before the contractual In-Service Date of 2027-05-13 -- normal lead time for a ~126MW single-axis-tracker solar array (12-18mo typical build) IF EIA's '(P)' status through Nov 2025 is accurate; the EIA '(U)' flip since Dec 2025 could not be corroborated or refuted with fresh imagery this session
Financial security posted and escalating on the IA's own schedule ($4.0M Aug 2025 -> $8.1M Nov 2025) is a real, contractually-binding commitment -- not typical of a paper/optionality project

Ch.313 tax abatement executed by Kerens ISD in 2022 ($40M value limitation on a project 'in excess of $162M' investment) shows 3+ years of consistent developer intent (Birch Creek Development / Elm Flats Solar LLC) predating and now converging with the IA -- strengthens confidence the COD claim reflects genuine schedule pressure, not queue-gaming

Risk: cumulative prior drift (~20 months) plus zero observed site activity with only ~10 months of pre-construction runway to In-Service Date warrants a MEDIUM drift risk rather than low; independent estimate widens the contractual quarter by one quarter to 2027-Q4 to reflect this
